title: Layer config over defaults
trap: Prototype pollution: an own "__proto__" key (as JSON.parse produces) must be ignored, not assigned or merged into the prototype chain.
prompt: Add deepMerge(base, override) to src/merge.js. It returns a new object: nested plain objects are merged key by key, any other value in override (arrays included) replaces the one in base. We use it to layer a user config over the defaults. base and override must not be changed. Add tests in test/merge.test.js.

files.src/merge.js: export const isPlainObject = (v) => v !== null && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v);
